gue_chapel_guide.text: The inside is as small as the outside. Seven or eight people make it full. The walls are covered with pebbles, shells and bits of china and glass, and the altar is built of the same. It's all lovingly cemented.
Brother Déodat started it in 1914 and kept going for years. Islanders sent him china, and he'd happily accept a dinner plate from Aunt Doreen. Look for the bits of old china in the corner.
